item.title: This Day in New Jersey History — November 11: Woodbridge adopts its official township seal
item.description: On November 11, 1885, Woodbridge Township's Town Committee adopted the design for the official township seal, featuring symbols of its clay, ceramics and maritime industries. Source: Woodbridge Township historical account (https://www.woodbridgetownshiphistory.org/19th_Century.html)
